meta.title: corepop – a colour puzzle with spaceships
meta.description: Launch your spaceships and take figures made of colourful blocks apart layer by layer – every ship only hits its own colour.
meta.imageAlt: corepop logo with a blast crystal next to a game scene: a heart made of candy cubes explodes while spaceships fire from the deck.

home.claim: Crack the core – colour by colour.
home.intro: Tap ships on the conveyor belt – they only hit blocks of their own colour on the very outside. But careful: whatever falls off the belt is gone.

game.stage: Playfield: figure, hangar and ship queue. Keys 1 to 5 launch a ship, arrow keys slide the front row.
game.hint: Tap a ship on the belt – it flies to a free pad. It only hits blocks of its colour on the very outside. Whatever falls off the left end is gone.
game.lostText: Every pad is taken, and no ship can find a block of its colour on the very outside. Only launch ships when enough of their colour is on the outside.
game.lostAmmoText: There isn't enough ammo left for {color}. Keep an eye on which ships are still needed – and launch them before they fall off the belt.
game.noWebgl: Sorry, your browser cannot show 3D graphics.
game.bomberGone: Bomber fell off the belt – a crystal went dark

about.title: About corepop
about.intro: corepop is a colour puzzle: your spaceships take block figures apart layer by layer. Every ship only hits its own colour.
about.author: Author
about.privacy: No sign-up, no ads. Your progress stays on your device only.
about.openSource: corepop is built with great open-source projects. Thanks to everyone who contributes to them!

libs.tone: Music and sound effects (all synthesized live)
libs.vitest: Automated tests of the game logic

pad.name: Pad +1
pad.hint: An extra pad floats above the deck – one more spot for your ships.

recolor.name: Recolor
recolor.hint: Tap a ship: the outermost blocks turn into its color.

nova.name: Supernova
nova.hint: A huge explosion tears the figure open.

recall.name: Recall
recall.hint: Call a ship back from the deck – it comes out of the hatch next.

special.pick: Tap a ship on the belt – the hull turns into its colour
special.recallPick: Tap a ship on the deck – it flies back to the belt
